EXP-017 bucket-quality audit on the tiny abstraction. Realized-EV-per-bucket from 60 deals/opponent, flop+turn hero decisions. between=6997544.1649 within=29401041.9619 ratio=0.2380 (n=294). Ratio < 1 means the current buckets do NOT separate realized-EV differences well — within-bucket variance dominates. This is the signal the EMD-rebuild (§4.1 / v3 A2) is meant to move: a better partition of the same space should raise between/within. Recorded as a baseline for the future EMD comparison; NO EMD rebuild run yet.

EXP-019 keep/kill decision data. Cold=254.57ms [234.97, 274.32] per call (full 1.7M-combo equity_exact vs a singleton villain range on empty board). Warm=16.052ns [15.813, 16.398] per call (hashmap hit). Ratio ~1.6e7x. VERDICT: memoization alone is sufficient when preflop all-in spots recur (which they do — the same (hero,villain) combo pair hits the same key). An offline GPU table is only justified if cold paths fire on sufficiently many DISTINCT combos that the 254ms-per-cold cost dominates a session. Given 1.7M possible pairs and typical session lengths, cold-dominated workloads are implausible: KEEP the memoized CPU implementation, CLOSE EXP-019 as 'memoization sufficient, GPU table NOT warranted'.
